notes.title: 🚀 Brave New Wonders - Update 2026/06/19 🌞
notes.content: [p]Here’s what’s new in our latest update:[/p][list][*][p]🧠 [b]Tech Tree Redesign[/b] – A cleaner, more intuitive progression system.[/p][/*][*][p]🎒 [b]Bigger Backpack[/b] – Starting inventory increased from 10 to 20 slots.[/p][/*][*][p]🔧 [b]Updated Toolbar[/b] – Slimmer design for better visibility during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]🪂 [b]Improved Supply Drops[/b] – Now much easier to spot![/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ [b]Crash Fixes[/b] – Resolved an issue related to space bar usage.[/p][/*][*][p]🔒 [b]Blueprint Mode Hidden Early On[/b] – To avoid overwhelming new players.[/p][/*][*][p]🤖 [b]New Tutorial[/b] – Learn how to assign tasks to your automatons.[/p][/*][*][p]⚡ [b]Dynamic Building Animations[/b] – Now react to power levels in real time.[/p][/*][*][p]❌ [b]Close Buttons Added[/b] – All windows now have a proper exit icon.[/p][/*][*][p]🔁 [b]View Switch Shortcut[/b] – Changed to Tab for quicker access.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing and stay tuned for more updates! 🏗️🌍[/p][p]Signup playtest now at [url="https://www.BraveNewWonders.com"]www.BraveNewWonders.com[/url] and join discussions at [url="https://discord.com/invite/cj2EYpY"]https://discord.com/invite/cj2EYpY[/url] . We will see you there! [/p]
